title: Concept: HSTS header without max-age
description: Strict-Transport-Security is present but has no max-age directive, and max-age is the only directive that enables the policy; a browser ignores the header entirely. The header therefore looks like transport protection in an inventory while enforcing nothing.
applicability: HTTPS responses that carry a Strict-Transport-Security header.
risk: No enforced HTTPS-only window; MEDIUM severity, and the defect is visible in the header text itself.
